title: Halves swap
prompt: Implement `void swapHalves(ArrayList<Integer> list)`: swap the halves in place. For odd sizes the middle element belongs to the SECOND half: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] → [3, 4, 5, 1, 2]. Work the index mapping on paper for sizes 4 and 5 before coding.

tests.name: halves swapped
tests.hint: half = size / 2; new position of index i is (i + half) % size.
